summary: Phlebotomist with roughly 20 years of experience across outpatient, mobile, nursing home, and donor collection settings, including preceptor responsibilities for new technicians. Performs aseptic venipuncture and capillary collection, specimen receiving, processing, and chronological prioritization, plus point-of-care microbiology screening such as rapid strep, HCG, RSV, and mono tests. Experienced in laboratory instrument maintenance, reviewing results and escalating abnormal findings, and maintaining CLIA, OSHA, and HIPAA compliance. Brings administrative and healthcare registration background, including EHR patient registration and clerical support.

credentials.name: Certified MCS+ Automated Blood Collection Tech
